section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces research on ethnic variations in gratitude and well-being, focusing on Latino and East Asian Americans compared to European Americans. Two studies are described: Study 1 investigated the emotional experience and expression of gratitude, finding Latino and European Americans reported higher levels than East Asian Americans. Study 2 examined the association between gratitude disposition and well-being indicators, revealing Latino Americans had a higher disposition toward gratitude than East Asian Americans, and higher gratitude disposition was generally linked to better well-being across groups, though some associations varied by group.
